mines.mine_notes: 100%-owned Moss Gold Project, northwestern Ontario. Jan 2026 PEA (all C$ unless noted): base case (US$2,750/oz Au, US$35/oz Ag) after-tax NPV5% C$2.232B, IRR 22.1%, 3.2-yr payback; long-term consensus (US$3,137/oz) NPV5% C$3.152B, IRR 28.1%; spot (US$4,600/oz) NPV5% C$6.578B, IRR 48.6%. Avg payable production ~265,000 oz Au + 374,000 oz Ag/yr over initial 13.2-yr LOM; AISC US$1,188/oz, cash costs US$999/oz (2nd quartile); initial capex C$2.001B (incl. C$303M contingency). Potential top-10 Canadian gold mine. No reserves defined (PEA-stage); PEA includes inferred resources. No FY2025 production.

notes: Formerly Goldshore Resources Inc.; renamed Gold X2 Mining Inc. Sept 2025. Listed TSX-V:AUXX and OTCQB:GSHRF; began trading on NYSE American (AUXX) Sept 8, 2026. Developer; no FY2025 production or revenue. Flagship Moss Gold Project PEA as above (all PEA economics in Canadian dollars). All amounts per Jan 26, 2026 news release.
